name: material-resolution
description: Every block the raycaster touches resolves to a definite acoustic Material derived from its tags.
positive_state: Block state -> stable identifier -> tag set -> blended physical properties -> baked Material; unknown blocks fall back to a defined default; the mapping is deterministic and reproducible across launches.
negative_state: Lookups silently miss and every block collapses to the air fallback (or null); the world is acoustically uniform; failures are invisible because they surface as a log line, not an error.
